submission.justification: R1 at 2 cm gives the highest pi/K separation at 10 GeV/c in the simulation scan (4.67 sigma). R3 peaks at 3.77 sigma at 3.5 cm, and R2 peaks at 2.86 sigma. No ageing reports were found for any candidate, so the hard requirement of at most 10% transparency loss is unverified for all three. R1 is the best choice on the stated goal. The ageing requirement must be confirmed with humidity-ageing data for R1 before this is relied on. If R1 fails that test, fall back to R3 at about 3.5 cm, then R2.
